reason: Hypothesis A proposes a clear, physically sound mechanism (heterophase interface pinning of dislocations) with a specific, testable intervention (refining vs. coarsening interfaces) and a well-defined falsification experiment, directly addressing creep resistance in the dual-phase coating. Hypothesis B, while citing evidence, introduces dynamic twinning and strain partitioning without a controlled intervention to isolate the proposed mechanism, and its baseline comparison to a single-phase FCC coating does not directly test the role of the FCC/BCC interfaces within the dual-phase system.
